parts.q: If I ______ more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gap qoidasiga ko'ra «If» qismida Past Simple ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If she lived in Tashkent, she ______ visit her cousins every weekend.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapning natija qismida «would + V1» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: We would buy a new car if we ______ enough money.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi qismda «would buy» kelgani uchun «If» bandida Past Simple (saved) kerak.

parts.q: If you ______ harder, you would pass the English exam.
parts.explain: Shart ergash gapida o'tgan zamon (Past Simple) qo'llanilishi shart.

parts.q: I ______ travel around the world if I won the lottery.
parts.explain: Natija qismida «would» yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If he ______ early, he wouldn't miss the bus.
parts.explain: Shart qismida Past Simple zamoni (got up) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: They would help us if they ______ how to fix the computer.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda «If» dan keyin fe'lning ikkinchi shakli keladi.

parts.q: If the weather ______ nice, we would go for a picnic in the mountains.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda shaxsning birligidan qat'i nazar «were» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: She would be very happy if she ______ a new smartphone.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda xayoliy vaziyat uchun «found» qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: If I ______ you, I wouldn't eat so much fast food.
parts.explain: Maslahat berishda «If I were you» qolipi doim ishlatiladi.

parts.q: What ______ you do if you saw a bear in the forest?
parts.explain: Savol shaklidagi natija qismida «would you do» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If Aziza ______ free tonight, she would join our party.
parts.explain: Faraz qilingan holat uchun «If» qismida «were» yoziladi.

parts.q: If my brother ______ a bike, he would ride it to the park.
parts.explain: Egalikni bildirish uchun «have» fe'lining Past Simple shakli «had» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: They would buy this house if it ______ so expensive.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda inkor ma'no uchun «weren't» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If I ______ the answer, I would tell you immediately.
parts.explain: Hozirgi paytdagi xayoliy holat uchun «knew» qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: You would feel better if you ______ to bed earlier.
parts.explain: Shart qismida fe'lning o'tgan zamon shakli «went» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If Jasur ______ a car, he would drive to Samarkand.
parts.explain: Past Simple zamonidagi «had» fe'li shartni bildiradi.

parts.q: I ______ buy a big house if I had a lot of money.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gap natijasida «would» yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If we ______ closer to school, we would walk every day.
parts.explain: Hozirgi real bo'lmagan holat uchun «lived» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: She would cook dinner if she ______ time.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gap qoidasiga ko'ra «had» yoziladi.

parts.q: If it ______ snow in summer, children would be very surprised.
parts.explain: O'tgan zamon yoki farazni bildirish uchun «did» kerak.

parts.q: He ______ speak English fluently if he lived in London.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gap natija qismi «would» bilan yasaladi.

parts.q: If they ______ hard, they would pass the test.
parts.explain: Shart ergash gapida Past Simple («tried») qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: I would help you with your homework if I ______ how to do it.
parts.explain: Faraz qilingan holat uchun Past Simple («understood») kerak.

parts.q: If Madina ______ a pet cat, she would play with it.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda «had» fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: We ______ win the match if we trained more often.
parts.explain: Natija qismida «would» yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If you ______ angry, you wouldn't say those things.
parts.explain: Inkor ma'nodagi ikkinchi shart gapda «weren't» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: He would buy a new laptop if his old one ______ broken.
parts.explain: Faraz qilingan holatni inkor qilish uchun «weren't» kerak.

parts.q: If I ______ wings, I would fly above the clouds.
parts.explain: Xayoliy vaziyat uchun «had» fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: They would visit us more often if they ______ so busy.
parts.explain: Shart qismida inkor ma'no uchun «weren't» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If she ______ the truth, she would tell us.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda Past Simple («knew») ishlatiladi.

parts.q: I ______ wear a jacket if it were cold outside.
parts.explain: Natija qismida «would» yordamchi fe'li qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: If Rustam ______ a bike, he would ride to the mountains.
parts.explain: Shart qismida «had» fe'li ishlatiladi.

parts.q: You would understand the lesson if you ______ attention.
parts.explain: Shart ergash gapida Past Simple («paid») qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: If the sun ______, we would go to the beach.
parts.explain: Xayoliy holat uchun «shine» fe'lining o'tgan zamoni «shone» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: We ______ move to a bigger flat if we had more money.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gap natijasida «would» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If I ______ a famous singer, I would give free concerts.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda «If I were» qolipi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: She would feel happier if she ______ more free time.
parts.explain: Faraz qilingan holat uchun Past Simple («had») kerak.

parts.q: If they ______ near the sea, they would swim every day.
parts.explain: Hozirgi paytdagi shart uchun «lived» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If Bobur ______ a faster runner, he would win the school race.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapda «be» fe'li barcha shaxslar uchun «were» shaklini oladi.

parts.q: Aziz arrived at the cinema. But the movie had already started. → When Aziz arrived at the cinema, the movie ______
parts.explain: Clue: «When Aziz arrived» o'tgan zamon, kino esa undan oldin boshlangan, shuning uchun past perfect (had already started).

parts.q: Shoira woke up early. But her younger brother had already left the house. → When Shoira woke up early, her younger brother ______
parts.explain: Uyg'onishdan oldin ukasi ketib bo'lgan, shuning uchun past perfect (had already left) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Jasur opened his locker. But someone had already taken his book. → When Jasur opened his locker, someone ______
parts.explain: Kitobni olish voqeasi oldinroq bo'lgani uchun past perfect (had taken) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Madina reached the bus stop. But the last bus had already gone. → When Madina reached the bus stop, the last bus ______
parts.explain: Clue: avtobus oldinroq ketib qolgan. Past perfect (had gone) qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: Otabek turned on the television. But the football match had already finished. → When Otabek turned on the television, the football match ______
parts.explain: O'yin oldinroq tugagan, shuning uchun past perfect (had finished) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Gulnora checked her pockets. But she had lost her house keys. → When Gulnora checked her pockets, she realized she ______
parts.explain: Kalitni yo'qotish harakati tekshirishdan oldin sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun past perfect (had lost) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Sherzod switched on his computer. But the internet connection had stopped working. → When Sherzod switched on his computer, the internet connection ______
parts.explain: Internetning o'chishi oldinroq sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun past perfect (had stopped) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Farhod looked at the plate. But his cat had already eaten the fish. → When Farhod looked at the plate, his cat ______
parts.explain: Clue: mushak baliqni yeb qo'yishi oldinroq bo'lgan, shuning uchun past perfect (had eaten).

parts.q: Ziyoda opened the fridge. But her mother had already cooked dinner. → When Ziyoda opened the fridge, her mother ______
parts.explain: Ovqat pishirish oldinroq bajarilgan, shuning uchun past perfect (had cooked) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Anvar looked outside the window. But it had already started to rain heavily. → When Anvar looked outside the window, it ______
parts.answer: had already started to rain heavily.
accept: had already begun to rain heavily
parts.explain: Yomg'ir oldinroq boshlangan, shuning uchun past perfect (had started) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Shahrizoda didn't eat any lunch. She had eaten a huge breakfast at home. → Shahrizoda didn't eat any lunch because she ______
parts.answer: had eaten a huge breakfast at home.
parts.explain: Sababiy gapda (because) o'tgan zamondagi sabab uchun past perfect (had eaten) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Bobur failed his history test. He hadn't studied the textbook carefully. → Bobur failed his history test because he ______
accept: had not studied the textbook carefully
parts.explain: Clue: imtihondan yomon baho olish sababi dars o'qimagani. Past perfect (hadn't studied) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Dilnoza was very tired on Monday morning. She hadn't slept well the night before. → Dilnoza was very tired on Monday morning because she ______
parts.answer: hadn't slept well the night before.
accept: had not slept well the night before
parts.explain: Charchash sababi oldingi kechada yaxshi uxlamagani, shuning uchun past perfect (hadn't slept) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Jamshid couldn't enter his classroom. He had forgotten his keys in the locker. → Jamshid couldn't enter his classroom because he ______
parts.answer: had forgotten his keys in the locker.
parts.explain: Kalitni unutib qo'yish oldinroq sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun past perfect (had forgotten) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Barno smiled happily at the party. She had passed her English exam with an A. → Barno smiled happily at the party because she ______
parts.answer: had passed her English exam with an A.
parts.explain: Clue: xursand bo'lish sababi imtihondan o'tgani. Past perfect (had passed) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Rustam didn't recognize his old classmate. His friend had grown a long beard. → Rustam didn't recognize his old classmate because his friend ______
parts.explain: Taniy olmaslik sababi do'stining soqol o'stirgani, shuning uchun past perfect (had grown) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Nargiza missed her favorite TV show. She had arrived home very late. → Nargiza missed her favorite TV show because she ______
parts.explain: Ko'rsatuvni ko'ra olmagani kech kelgani bilan bog'liq, shuning uchun past perfect (had arrived) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Sardor's hands were very dirty. He had repaired his bicycle chain. → Sardor's hands were very dirty because he ______
parts.explain: Clue: qo'llari kir bo'lishining sababi zanjirni tuzatgani. Past perfect (had repaired) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Gulnora failed to catch the morning train. She had left her bag at home. → Gulnora failed to catch the morning train because she ______
parts.answer: had left her bag at home.
parts.explain: Poyezdga ulgurmagani sumkasini uyda unutgani uchun, shuning uchun past perfect (had left) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Ulugbek was very sad about the match. His favorite team had lost 3-0. → Ulugbek was very sad about the match because his favorite team ______
parts.explain: Xafa bo'lish sababi sevimli jamoasining yutqazgani, shuning uchun past perfect (had lost) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The train departed from the station. Before that, Dilshod had bought a ticket. → Before Dilshod got on the train, he ______
parts.explain: «Before» bog'lovchisidan keyin past simple, asosiy qismda esa oldingi harakat uchun past perfect (had bought) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The sun set behind the mountains. Before that, the children had finished playing football. → Before the sun set, the children ______
parts.explain: Clue: quyosh botguncha futbol o'ynab bo'lingan edi. Past perfect (had finished) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The teacher entered the classroom. Before that, the students had opened their notebooks. → Before the teacher entered the classroom, the students ______
parts.explain: O'qituvchi kirishidan oldinft daftar ochilgan edi, shuning uchun past perfect (had opened) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The heavy rain started to fall. Before that, we had reached our home. → Before the heavy rain started, we ______
parts.explain: Yomg'ir boshlanguncha uyga yetib borilgan edi, shuning uchun past perfect (had reached) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The guests arrived at the house. Before that, mother had baked a delicious cake. → Before the guests arrived, mother ______
parts.explain: Clue: mehmonlar kelguniga qadar tort pishirib bo'lingan edi. Past perfect (had baked) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The phone rang loudly. Before that, I had turned off the stove. → Before the phone rang, I ______
parts.explain: Telefon jiringlashidan oldin plita o'chirilgan edi, shuning uchun past perfect (had turned off) ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Madina finished her homework. After that, she played a computer game. → After Madina had finished her homework, she ______
parts.explain: «After» so'zidan keyin Past Perfect keladi, ikkinchi qismda esa Past Simple ishlatiladi: played a computer game.

parts.q: Timur ate all the apples. After that, he drank a glass of water. → After Timur had eaten all the apples, he ______
parts.explain: Gapda «After» qoidasi qo'llaniladi. Birinchi harakat Past Perfect (had eaten), ikkinchisi Past Simple: drank a glass of water.

parts.q: Malika cleaned her room. After that, her mother gave her some chocolate. → After Malika had cleaned her room, her mother ______
parts.explain: Xona tozalangach, onasi shokolad berdi. «After» dan keyin Past Perfect, keyingi qismda Past Simple: gave her some chocolate.

parts.q: The lesson ended. After that, the students ran out of the classroom. → After the lesson had ended, the students ______
parts.explain: Dars tugashi birinchi sodir bo'lgan (had ended), shuning uchun keyingi qism Past Simple zamonida keladi: ran out of the classroom.

parts.q: If Dilshod ______ free time today, he would play football with us.
parts.explain: Gapda ikkinchi shart ergash gapi kelgan: «would play» bor, shuning uchun If qismida Past Simple ishlatiladi: had.

wrong.have: Ikkinchi shart gapida Present Simple ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.has: Ikkinchi shart gapida 'has' noto'g'ri, chunki o'tgan zamon shakli kerak.

parts.q: If Zarina ______ French, she would travel to Paris next month.
parts.explain: Ikkinchi shart gapining natija qismida «would travel» turgani uchun, If qismida Past Simple — «spoke» ishlatiladi.

wrong.speak: Present Simple ikkinchi shart gapiga mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: If we ______ enough money, we would buy a new computer.
parts.explain: Natija qismida «would buy» borligi sababli, shart qismida Past Simple — «saved» qo'yiladi.

wrong.save: Present Simple ikkinchi shart gapida qo'llanilmaydi.
wrong.saves: Uchinchi shaxs birlik qo'shimchasi shart gapida ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.had saved: Bu yerda Past Perfect emas, oddiy Past Simple kerak.

parts.q: If Sardor ______ harder, he would pass all his exams easily.
parts.explain: Natija qismida «would pass» bor, shuning uchun shart qismida Past Simple — «studied» ishlatiladi.

wrong.study: Bu Present Simple, ikkinchi shart gapiga mos emas.
wrong.studies: Present Simple uchinchi shaxs shakli bu yerga tushmaydi.
wrong.had studied: O'tgan zamondagi oddiy shart uchun Past Simple ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ stay at home.
parts.explain: Bu birinchi shart gapidir («First conditional»): If + Present Simple, natija qismida esa «will» ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: O'tgan zamon yordamchi fe'li bu yerga mos kelmaydi.
wrong.had: Past Perfect birinchi shart gapida ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: If you miss the bus, you ______ be late for school.
parts.explain: Hozirgi/kelajakdagi real vaziyat uchun birinchi shart: If + Present Simple, natijada «will» keladi.

wrong.would: Ikkinchi shart zamoni bu yerda noto'g'ri.
wrong.are: Faqat 'are'ning o'zi kelajak oqibatini bildira olmaydi.

parts.q: If Dilshod finishes his homework early, he ______ play computer games.
parts.explain: Birinchi shart gapida shart qismi Present Simple bo'lsa, natija qismida «will» ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: O'tgan zamon shakli bu yerga mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: If you touch that hot pan, you ______ burn your hand.
parts.explain: Aniq natijali birinchi shart gapida «will» ishlatiladi.

wrong.would: Bu xayoliy shart emas, real xavf.
wrong.did: O'tgan zamon bu yerga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
wrong.were: Ikkinchi shart fe'li bu yerda xato.

parts.q: When Umid arrived at the station, the train ______ already left.
parts.explain: Gapda «already left» (V3) bor, shuning uchun o'tgan zamonda undan oldin sodir bo'lgan ish-harakatni ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: Gap o'tgan zamonda («arrived»), shuning uchun Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li bu yerda V3 bilan ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.was: Majburiy o'timli fe'l oldidan 'was' emas, 'had' kerak.

parts.q: When Lola opened her bag, she realized she ______ lost her pen.
parts.explain: O'tgan zamondagi asosiy voqea («opened») dan oldin sodir bo'lgan ish uchun Past Perfect — «had» qo'yiladi.

wrong.has: Hozirgi zamon yordamchi fe'li o'tgan zamon matniga mos kelmaydi.
wrong.did: 'lost' fe'li oldidan 'did' ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: By the time the teacher came into the room, the students ______ opened their books.
parts.explain: O'qituvchi kelishidan oldin sodir bo'lgan harakatni ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect («had») ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li bu yerga mos emas.

parts.q: When Sanjar turned on the light, he saw that someone ______ eaten his cake.
parts.explain: O'tgan zamondagi «saw» harakatidan oldin sodir bo'lgan ish uchun Past Perfect «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: O'tgan zamon matnida Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.did: V3 shakli bilan 'did' ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: When the lights went out, we ______ already finished our dinner.
parts.explain: Chiroq o'chgunga qadar ovqat yeb bo'lingan edi, shuning uchun Past Perfect («had») kerak.

wrong.did: O'tgan zamon savol/inkor fe'li bu yerda xato.

parts.q: Aziza didn't eat dinner because she ______ eaten a big lunch.
parts.explain: Sababiy bog'lamadan keyin o'tgan zamondan oldingi ishni ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: Matn o'tgan zamonda («didn't eat»), shuning uchun 'has' ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.did: V3 shaklidagi fe'l oldidan 'did' qo'yilmaydi.
wrong.was: Fe'lning bu shakli bu yerga mos emas.

parts.q: Rustam failed his test because he ______ studied the grammar rules.
parts.explain: Imtihondan yiqilishidan oldin dars qilmaganini bildirish uchun inkor shakldagi Past Perfect («hadn't») ishlatiladi.

wrong.hasn't: O'tgan zamon hikoyasida Present Perfect inkor shakli ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.didn't: Past Simple inkoridan keyin fe'lning 1-shakli kelishi kerak edi.

parts.q: Madina was very sleepy in the morning because she ______ slept well.
parts.explain: O'tgan zamondagi holatdan oldin uxlamaganini ko'rsatish uchun «hadn't» ishlatiladi.

wrong.didn't: 'didn't' dan keyin 'slept' (V2/V3) emas, 'sleep' (V1) kelishi kerak edi.

parts.q: Temur couldn't open the door because he ______ forgotten his keys.
parts.explain: Eshikni ocha olmagan paytdan oldin kalitni unutib qo'ygani uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: O'tgan zamon voqealari uchun 'has' mos kelmaydi.
wrong.did: V3 shakli bilan 'did' ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.was: 'forgotten' fe'lidan oldin 'was' turganda majburiy nisbat ma'nosi chiqib qoladi va xato bo'ladi.

parts.q: Gulnora smiled happily because she ______ passed her exam.
parts.explain: Tabassum qilishidan oldin imtihondan o'tgani uchun Past Perfect «had» talab qilinadi.

wrong.has: Hozirgi zamon yordamchi fe'li o'tgan zamon hikoyasiga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li V3 bilan kelmaydi.
wrong.were: Shaxs va fe'l shakli mos emas.

parts.q: Before Jasur got on the train, he ______ bought a ticket.
parts.explain: «Before» so'zidan keyin Past Simple kelganda, boshqa qismda o'tgan zamondan oldingi ish uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: O'tgan zamondagi voqea uchun Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.did: V3 shakli bilan 'did' ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.was: Fe'l zamoni bu yerga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

parts.q: Before the sun set, the children ______ finished playing football.
parts.explain: Quyosh botishidan oldin sodir bo'lib bo'lgan ish uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li bu yerda ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: Before the teacher entered the room, the students ______ opened their notebooks.
parts.explain: O'qituvchi kirishidan oldin sodir bo'lgan harakat uchun Past Perfect — «had» qo'yiladi.

wrong.did: V3 shaklidagi fe'l oldidan 'did' qo'yilmaydi.

parts.q: Before the heavy rain started, we ______ reached our home.
parts.explain: Yomg'ir boshlanishidan oldin uyga yetib kelingan edi, shuning uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.have: Present Perfect o'tgan zamondagi ketma-ketlikka mos kelmaydi.
wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li bu yerga qo'yilmaydi.
wrong.were: Bu yerda o'tgan davomiy zamon ma'nosi talab qilinmaydi.

parts.q: Before the guests arrived, mother ______ baked a delicious cake.
parts.explain: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin pirojniy pishirib bo'lingan edi, shuning uchun Past Perfect — «had» kerak.

wrong.did: V3 shaklidagi fe'l bilan 'did' kelmaydi.
wrong.was: Majburiy nisbat hosil bo'lib qoladi va xato.

parts.q: After Madina ______ finished her homework, she played a computer game.
parts.explain: «After» bog'lamasidan keyin avval sodir bo'lgan ish uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: O'tgan zamondagi ikkinchi qismga nisbatan 'has' xato.
wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li V3 bilan ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.was: Fe'l shakli bu yerga mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: After Timur ______ eaten all the apples, he drank a glass of water.
parts.explain: «After» dan keyin o'tgan zamonda avval yuz bergan ish ko'rsatiladi: Past Perfect — «had».

wrong.has: Gapning ikkinchi qismi o'tgan zamonda («drank»), shuning uchun 'has' xato.
wrong.did: 'eaten' (V3) oldidan 'did' qo'yilmaydi.
wrong.was: Majburiy nisbat yuzaga kelib xato bo'ladi.

parts.q: After Malika ______ cleaned her room, her mother gave her some chocolate.
parts.explain: Avval xona tozalandi, keyin ona shokolad berdi. Oldingi harakat uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.has: O'tgan zamon hikoyasida Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li V3 bilan ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: After the lesson ______ ended, the students ran out of the classroom.
parts.explain: Dars tugagandan keyin o'quvchilar yugurib chiqdi. Oldingi harakat uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: V3 shakli bilan 'did' ishlatilmaydi.

parts.q: After Bobur ______ read the book, he returned it to the library.
parts.explain: Kitobni o'qib bo'lgach kutubxonaga qaytardi. Avvalgi ish uchun Past Perfect — «had» ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: Past Simple yordamchi fe'li bu yerga mos emas.

parts.q: If our team ______ better, we would win the championship.
parts.explain: Natija qismida «would win» bor, shuning uchun shart qismida Past Simple — «played» ishlatiladi.

wrong.play: Present Simple ikkinchi shart gapida ishlatilmaydi.
wrong.plays: Uchinchi shaxs birlik shakli bu yerda xato.
wrong.had played: Ikkinchi shart gapining shart qismida Past Simple ishlatiladi.

parts.q: If you ask politely, she ______ help you with your homework.
parts.explain: Bu birinchi shart gapidir: If + Present Simple, natija qismida esa «will» ishlatiladi.

wrong.did: O'tgan zamon yordamchi fe'li bu yerga mos emas.

intro.what: Ikkinchi shartli gaplar (Second Conditional) hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy vaziyatlarni va ularning natijalarini bildiradi. O'tgan tugallangan zamon (Past Perfect) esa o'tgan zamonda boshqa bir harakatdan oldin sodir bo'lgan voqeani ko'rsatadi.
when: Hozirgi paytda ro'y berishi qiyin bo'lgan xayoliy ishlarni aytish uchun
O'tgan zamondagi ikkita ish-harakatning ketma-ketligini ko'rsatish uchun

structures.label: Second Conditional (Affirmative)
structures.example_en: If I had a bike, I would ride to school.
structures.example_uz: Agar menda velosiped bo'lganida, maktabga haydab borgan bo'lar edim.

structures.label: Second Conditional (Question)
structures.formula: What would you do if + Past Simple?
structures.example_en: What would you do if you saw a lion?
structures.example_uz: Agar arslonni ko'rganingda nima qilgan bo'lar eding?

structures.label: Past Perfect (Affirmative)
structures.example_en: She had finished her homework before dinner.
structures.example_uz: U kechki ovqatdan oldin uy vazifasini tugatgan edi.

structures.label: Past Perfect (Negative)
structures.example_en: We hadn't visited Samarkand before last summer.
structures.example_uz: Biz o'tgan yozgacha Samarqandga bormagan edik.

rules.title: Xayoliy shartlar
rules.text: Second Conditional gaplarida 'if' qismida o'tgan zamon fe'li keladi, lekin ma'no hozirgi yoki kelajak zamonga tegishli bo'ladi.

examples.en: If I were rich, I would buy a nice house in Tashkent.
examples.uz: Agar boy bo'lganimda, Toshkentda chiroyli uy sotib olgan bo'lar edim.

examples.en: If he studied harder, he would pass the exam.
examples.uz: Agar u qattiqroq o'qiganda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lar edi.

rules.title: O'tdagi birinchi harakat
rules.text: Past Perfect o'tgan zamondagi boshqa bir harakatdan oldin tugallangan ishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: When I arrived at the station, the train had left.
examples.uz: Men vokzalga kelganimda, poyezd ketib bo'lgan edi.

examples.en: Dad was angry because I had lost my keys.
examples.uz: Dadam jahl qildi, chunki men kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ygan edim.

rules.title: After va Before bog'lamalari
rules.text: Past Perfect ko'pincha 'after' yoki 'before' so'zlari bilan birga ishlatilib, voqealar ketma-ketligini aniq ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: After she had eaten lunch, she went out to play football.
examples.uz: U tushlikni yeb bo'lgach, futbol o'ynagani chiqib ketdi.

examples.en: They had cleaned the room before guests arrived.
examples.uz: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin ular xonani tozalab qo'yishgan edi.

mistakes.wrong: If I will have money, I will buy a car.
mistakes.right: If I had money, I would buy a car.
mistakes.why: Second conditional qoidasiga ko'ra, 'if' qismida 'will' emas, o'tgan zamon fe'li ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: She had went home before it started to rain.
mistakes.right: She had gone home before it started to rain.
mistakes.why: Past Perfect zamonida fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3) ishlatilishi kerak, 'went' esa ikkinchi shakl.

mistakes.wrong: If I was you, I would study English.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would study English.
mistakes.why: Ikkinchi shartli gaplarda maslahat berganda 'I', 'he', 'she' olmoshlari bilan ham 'was' emas, 'were' ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I lost my phone because I left it on the bus.
mistakes.right: I lost my phone because I had left it on the bus.
mistakes.why: Telefonni yo'qotishdan oldin avtobusda qoldirgani uchun Past Perfect ishlatilishi kerak.
